title: Shammar–Obaidi war (1814–1817)
text: In the 1800s, after the Al Obeidi, were kicked out of Najd, by the First Saudi state, they had Quickly established a presence in the Al-Jazira, and started to rival the influential Shammar tribe, and tensions had spiked quickly, as the Ottoman Empire, had tried to keep peace and control over Iraq through military alliances and negotiations with both the Sultans of the tribe.
